text: 为什么我们总希望有一个足够厉害的人，
en: Why do we keep looking for someone powerful enough

text: 来解决人生所有的问题？
en: to solve every problem in life?

text: 一个好领袖、好老板，或理想伴侣。
en: A good leader, a good boss, or the ideal partner.

text: 我们以为，只要找到对的人，一切就会变好。
en: We think the right person will make everything better.

text: 以色列人也这样想。
en: Israel thought so too.

text: 他们要求一个王，像其他国家一样，
en: They wanted a king, like the other nations,

text: 带领他们争战，给他们安全感。
en: to lead their battles and make them feel secure.

text: 但神在撒母耳记上八章七节说：
en: But in First Samuel 8:7, God said:

text: 因为他们不是厌弃你，
en: “They have not rejected you,

text: 乃是厌弃我，不要我作他们的王。
en: but they have rejected me as their king.”

text: 后来，扫罗成为王，却因不顺服而失败。
en: Saul became king, but failed through disobedience.

text: 神拣选大卫，但大卫同样犯罪。
en: God chose David, but David also sinned.

text: 这让我们看见：人的王再有能力，
en: This shows us that even the most capable human king

text: 也无法解决人心中的罪。
en: cannot solve the sin within the human heart.

text: 然而，神没有放弃祂的计划。
en: Yet God did not abandon his plan.

text: 祂在撒母耳记下七章十六节应许大卫：
en: In Second Samuel 7:16, he promised David:

text: 你的家和你的国必在我面前永远坚立。
en: “Your house and your kingdom shall endure before me.

text: 你的国位也必坚定，直到永远。
en: Your throne shall be established forever.”

text: 这应许最终指向耶稣基督。
en: This promise ultimately points to Jesus Christ.

text: 祂是完全顺服、为罪人舍命，
en: He obeyed perfectly and gave his life for sinners,

text: 从死里复活的永恒君王。
en: rising from death as the eternal King.

text: 所以，撒母耳记真正的问题不是：
en: So the real question in Samuel is not:

text: 谁有能力领导我们？
en: Who is capable of leading us?

text: 而是：谁真正值得我们一生信靠？
en: But: Who deserves our lifelong trust?

text: 你呢？你把生命的安全感放在谁身上？
en: What about you? Where do you place your security?

text: 这里是 SoulQuake，用圣经回应真实，
en: This is SoulQuake: meeting real life with Scripture,

text: 用真道震撼灵魂。
en: shaking the soul with the truth.
